title: Life Plan Contract Terms — Entrance Fee Agreement Plans and Independent Living Late Fees
content:
A resident holding an occupied Entrance Fee Agreement has the late fee percentage on the Independent Living Residency Agreement account lowered by the plan's terms.

## Term

| Customer's Entrance Fee Agreement | Lowering of the late fee percentage |
|---|---|
| Occupied, under a lifecare plan | 0.75 percentage point |
| Occupied, under a fee-for-service plan | 0.25 percentage point |
| No occupied Entrance Fee Agreement | No plan reduction |

The lowering is subtracted from the late fee percentage, never below zero, before the percentage is applied to the past-due amount of the billing period.

## What is read

The status of the customer's Entrance Fee Agreement (occupied or not) and the contract type of its plan (lifecare or fee-for-service). An Entrance Fee Agreement that is not occupied — for example one still reserved — brings no plan reduction.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A resident at Larkspur at Willow Creek holds an occupied Entrance Fee Agreement under a lifecare plan: a late fee percentage of 1.5 is lowered by 0.75 point to 0.75 percent.
- A resident holds an occupied Entrance Fee Agreement under a fee-for-service plan: a late fee percentage of 3.0 is lowered by 0.25 point to 2.75 percent.
- A resident whose only Entrance Fee Agreement is reserved: no plan reduction.
- A late fee percentage of 0.5 lowered by 0.75 point does not become negative; it stops at zero.
